status: Design only; no paid run or product behavior change
objective: Separate communication cost from model quality and fixed output serialization before multiplayer claims.
invariants: Same source fixtures, tool availability, CLI/model/effort and normal continuous session per arm.
Disable native automatic memory on every launch; collect actual reported input/cache/output/reasoning subset and gaps.
Preserve failed and truncated attempts; never rerun until pass or compute full-run ratios from unequal coverage.
Host binds exact delivered causal context; only explicit authenticated actions publish.
Do not add scenario-specific product roles, workflows or prompts.

singleSessionNext.workload: A bounded real file-editing task with successive user-requested changes and independently executed artifact checks.
singleSessionNext.quality: Check final files and calculations independently of conversational response format; keep protocol/schema errors a separate failure category.
singleSessionNext.controls: Freeze tasks, expected artifact invariants, cutoff, model binding, paired order and sample count before models run.
singleSessionNext.report: Whole-task cost, per-round cost, first request, late window, number of business tool calls, extra protocol generations, output serialization and incomplete-usage events. No automatic attribution of all differences to Loom.
singleSessionNext.codexInvocation: Use ordinary codex exec and explicit-session exec resume as the native control, with automatic memory disabled on every launch. Both commands expose --output-schema for the experimental final-reply arm. Record CLI entry point separately from the internal code-mode tool backend. If an invocation-local backend feature is changed to avoid an OS startup blocker, apply it equally to both arms and label it a configured variant, not the unchanged default baseline. P140 app-server control is retained as its own failed experiment.
singleSessionNext.qualityFailureHandling: For a future separately preregistered design, distinguish transport/security/usage failure from a wrong business answer. If later tasks remain well-defined and no unsafe state mutation occurred, execute the fixed remaining paired sequence, record each answer error without supplying the oracle or rerunning it, and report whole-trajectory usage jointly with quality. Unequal quality never qualifies as an efficiency win. Existing P137/P139/P144 stop-at-first-error plans and observations remain unchanged; this is not authorization to resume them under altered rules.

pairedSessionNext.baseline: Two native CLI sessions with the same public replies manually relayed; actual Herdr baseline only from a verified Herdr-managed environment.
pairedSessionNext.loom: Two instances exchange only intended Room reply deltas under existing auth/delivery fences.
pairedSessionNext.fairness: Same user objective and input artifacts, participant model assignments, intervention rules and stopping criteria. Count both sessions and all failed attempts.
pairedSessionNext.quality: Independent accepted artifact and demonstrated reviewer contribution, not number of chat messages.
pairedSessionNext.limits: No claim against commercial collaboration libraries without matched implemented baseline and primary-source configuration audit.
